verdict.rationale: Reflect's note-history docs say edits are recorded continuously, so users can see all their changes and revert a note to any point in time. That covers the core of viewing version history and restoring earlier versions. The evidence is a single first-party statement with no detail on how the history UI works. Missing for 10: evidence of recovering deleted notes (trash/undelete), detail on the history viewer, independent or hands-on corroboration.
